scope: Read-only source and mathematical review. No source edits, tests, analyzer execution on historic data, workflow dispatch or changed verdict.

methodFindings.finding: Interval enclosure is mathematically justified conditional on each sample error bound.
methodFindings.reason: Nearest-rank p95 is componentwise monotone. For paired log-ratio vector x, mean(x)+c*norm(Px) is convex and mean(x)-c*norm(Px) is concave, so maximum upper/minimum lower endpoints over an interval rectangle occur at vertices. Ten pairs give1024 vertices; df9 critical2.263 is rounded conservatively.
methodFindings.peer: Independent source/math review by status_checks agrees; no tests executed.

methodFindings.reason: The target is geometric mean of per-run p95 on/off ratios under independent matched pairs and approximately normal pair log ratios, not pooled-frame p95 or a universal/device claim. ABBA ordering/fresh profiles do not prove independence or remove all serial host drift.

methodFindings.finding: Minimum observed clock increment is not a justified uniform error bound.
methodFindings.reason: The browser probe samples a separate same-origin page for100ms and requires20 positive increments. W3C permits implementation-defined coarsening and jitter; observing a minimum increment cannot establish the maximum duration error or later clock-policy stability.

methodFindings.finding: Journal method measures only synchronous invoked hook/application envelopes.
methodFindings.reason: Setup, observer delivery/drain/export, meter instructions outside endpoints, GPU work and total-browser CPU remain unobserved by explicit scope.

acceptanceGap.severity: Blocks unconditional prospective <=5% qualification; no current passing native result is asserted.

nativeAdapter.effect: Promotes either analyzer label to row.status=passed without an independently justified bound.

proposedCorrection.method: Use a separately versioned prospective assessment; retain computed intervals as conditional sensitivity evidence, but return unresolved/nonpassing for qualification when only empirical minimum-step evidence exists.
proposedCorrection.boundAdmission: Only a separately reviewed and exact source/browser/policy-bound error contract could justify a bounded qualification claim; do not use a self-reported flag or infer it from minimum step.
